title: Pencil AI Alternatives With a Team That Makes the Ads for You
summary: Compare Pencil AI alternatives where a team makes the ads: Knowlify, Creatify Studio, Airpost and Admiral Media, by volume, price and who runs the campaigns.
body_markdown:
Knowlify is our top Pencil alternative with a team that makes the ads: it delivers about 25 finished AI video ads a week for Facebook and Instagram, a person checks every one, and it can run your Meta campaigns or deliver creative only. Creatify Studio, Airpost and Admiral Media also sell done-for-you production, while Pencil is self-serve software that your team runs. Choose by who does the making, not by which feature list looks longer. Knowlify publishes this guide and sells one of the services compared.


## What does Pencil do, and what does it leave to you?


As of October 2026,[Pencil](https://trypencil.com/) describes itself as an AI operating system for marketing. It brings models from OpenAI, Google, Adobe, Runway and Stability AI into one platform, with governance controls aimed at enterprises. Its plans include self-serve AI agents for text, images, video and ad creatives, real-time AI insights and scores, and launching and tracking ads on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Google Display, DV360 and LinkedIn.


The entry plan on its[pricing page](https://trypencil.com/pricing) is $14 a month billed monthly for 50 generations, and the plan is self-serve. That model suits a team with a creative lead who can brief the tool, review its output and decide what ships. A done-for-you provider replaces that work with your brief and its own review step.

Pencil appears last as the reference point. Every other row is a provider that delivers finished work, so the comparison is about who does the making.


## Knowlify: our top pick when a team should make the ads


Knowlify is the best fit if you are leaving a self-serve tool because your team no longer has the hours to brief it, review its output and cut the ads. Knowlify handles that whole path. It makes about 25 finished ads a week in three formats: AI UGC with AI presenters, 3D and stylized character animation, and AI commercials. The first batch lands on day 5, and a person checks every ad before delivery, which replaces the review step you would otherwise do yourself.


Where Pencil launches ads from inside the tool, Knowlify offers a choice: end-to-end Meta campaign management, or creative only if you already have a buyer. Pricing is a custom quote on a[30-minute call](https://knowlify.com/book) . Where Knowlify runs the account, the guarantee is an agreed target in 30 days, or you don't pay for the month. On creative-only plans, if the ads have not made more than you paid in the first 90 days, you can cancel by email for a full refund (terms on the site, see the[pricing and guarantee section](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency#pricing) ).


Pick another option if you need ads on TikTok, LinkedIn, Google or YouTube, which Pencil's platform lists and Knowlify does not run, or if you need real human creators, which Knowlify does not supply.


## Creatify Studio and Airpost: managed production with a team


[Creatify Studio](https://creatify.ai/studio) is its done-for-you service. Creatify says a creative team handles strategy, scripting and production, a person reviews every ad, and Studio delivers 25 to 100+ videos a month with a 48-hour turnaround. Its public pages do not say whether Studio runs campaigns, so ask before you sign.


[Airpost's pricing page](https://www.airpost.ai/pricing) starts at $6,000 a month and includes its platform, a dedicated AI video production team, a Slack channel and an editor for copy and voiceover. It says Airpost trains a custom model for your brand and uploads ads into your Meta account the way you specify. Confirm the output in your plan, since the page describes 10 to 100 or more ads without fixing a count.
